threads.title: Make the interaction face easy to find

events.author: ai
events.body: Observation: the vending model has a distinct front face and a fixed footprint. The front should be readable from the approach, while its base and sides should not suggest extra usable space. Tradeoff: oversized screen or trim accents can improve readability but overwhelm the everyday street-furniture silhouette. Review the front at gameplay distance, then check side clearance in the level. Source: src/game/street-props.ts.

threads.title: Keep the two systems visually distinct

events.author: ai
events.body: Supersedes thread oicw-silhouette-intent (model-4134f4ea, 2026-11-11), whose model fingerprint changed when the cargo weapons were given rounded and stepped cross-sections on 2026-11-15. The side outline, muzzle heights and feed positions were kept; the upper shell now narrows towards the launcher muzzle. Original note, unchanged: The catalogue describes stacked rifle/launcher muzzles, an integrated upper body and separate feed silhouettes. Those differences are the visual explanation for the two firing modes. Tradeoff: too much upper-body mass can hide the supporting rifle profile. Review both sides and a small on-screen silhouette before adding detail. This concerns the fictional game model’s visual readability. Source: src/game/proxy-weapon-models.ts.
